comment: Per-vendor MCP server registry. Each entry becomes one stdio MCP server (mcp/vendor-server.mjs --vendor <key>) exposing only its namespaces' tools under bare names — the realistic topology where an agent connects to each product's own MCP server. The runner surfaces tools to the LLM as <vendor>__<tool>, the standard multi-server convention. Namespace tool counts are for the wave-6 world sbx_291042075d7547f4.

salesforce-crm.blurb: CRM of record: accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, cases, tasks.

stripe-billing.blurb: Billing: customers, subscriptions, invoices, charges, payments.

sendgrid-email.blurb: Outbound email infrastructure: sends, suppressions, deliverability.

slack.blurb: Deal-room messaging: channels, messages, scheduled posts.

notion-docs.blurb: Knowledge base and document store: SOPs, battlecards, artifacts.

github.blurb: Sheets/exports surface used by RevOps tooling.

revops-core.blurb: Company-internal records, workflows, documents, sheets, memories, sub-agents.
